name: Bleum in Lucent
source:
A mysterious book.  A series of murders. 

A fate that keeps repeating. Set in a foggy corner of an old city, "Bleum in Lucent" is a narrative mystery visual novel about a young newspaper seller who discovers a book that seems to predict murders before they happen. Investigate the people, uncover their stories, and follow the clues hidden throughout the city.

[From [url=https://bleum-in-lucent.itch.io/bleum-in-lucent]itch.io[/url]]
